seo.meta_title: Why Is Five Guys So Expensive?
seo.meta_description: Five Guys costs more than typical fast food because of fresh ingredients, big portions, free toppings and peanuts. Here's what you're paying for.
seo.h1: Why Is Five Guys So Expensive?
seo.primary_keyword: why is five guys so expensive

question: Why Is Five Guys So Expensive?
quick_answer: Five Guys costs more than typical fast food because of what goes into each order. It uses fresh, never-frozen beef, cooks everything to order, gives generous portions, includes unlimited free toppings, piles the fry cups high, and offers free peanuts. You are paying for a bigger, fresher, made-to-order meal rather than a cheap value-menu burger.
key_facts: Fresh, never-frozen beef cooked to order
Large portions, especially the overfilled fries
All toppings are free, which is built into the base price
Priced as a premium fast-casual burger, not value fast food

body.heading: Fresh, made-to-order food
body.text: A big reason for the price is that Five Guys uses fresh, never-frozen beef and cooks each burger to order rather than holding food under a heat lamp. Fresh ingredients and cooking on demand cost more than the pre-made, value-focused approach of cheaper chains.

body.heading: Big portions and free extras
body.text: Five Guys is known for generous servings. The fries are famously overfilled, the burgers are hefty, and all toppings are free rather than added-cost. Most stores also give out free peanuts. Those extras are not really free; the cost is built into the menu price, which pushes the base price up.

body.heading: A premium position
body.text: Five Guys positions itself as a premium fast-casual burger brand rather than a budget option. Between quality ingredients, large portions and free toppings, a meal ends up priced higher than a typical fast-food combo, which is why it feels expensive. Whether it is worth it depends on how much you value the size and freshness.

faqs.q: Why does Five Guys cost more than other fast food?
faqs.a: It uses fresh, never-frozen beef, cooks to order, gives big portions, includes free toppings and free peanuts, and positions itself as premium rather than budget fast food.

faqs.q: Are the toppings really free at Five Guys?
faqs.a: Yes, toppings are included at no extra charge, but that cost is built into the base price, which is part of why Five Guys feels pricey.

faqs.q: Do you get a lot of food at Five Guys?
faqs.a: Portions are generous. The fries are famously overfilled and the burgers are large, so you typically get more food than a standard fast-food order.
